retrievalProfile.description: A weightless, monochromatic blue underwater portrait featuring a crouched figure illuminated by a soft upward spotlight against a deep, hazy void.
excludeWhen: bubbles and surface reflections are required

recipe.visualDefinition: A serene, low-contrast underwater scene dominated by a deep indigo palette. A central figure in a dark dress is captured in a crouched, floating posture, with hair billowing upward. The lighting is localized, creating a soft glow on the figure's skin and the floor beneath them, while the rest of the environment fades into a grainy, dark blue haze.
coreVisualRelationships: figure to void ratio emphasizing isolation
upward light source to skin luminosity
monochromatic blue tones to atmospheric depth
coreInvariants: Absence of visible bubbles or surface ripples

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: The subject is centered horizontally and placed in the lower two-thirds of the frame, appearing small against the vast blue space above.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The brightest point of the image—the figure's illuminated skin and the light pool on the 'floor'.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: The eye follows the light from the bottom up to the subject's face, then follows the upward flow of the hair into the dark void.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive negative space in the upper half of the frame creates a sense of crushing depth and silence.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pale Cyan/White (Illuminated skin and light source)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation with a focus on value shifts within the blue spectrum; high value only in the direct path of the light.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an underwater scene in deep indigo tones. A figure in a dark dress is crouched and floating in the lower center. A soft, diffused spotlight shines from below, illuminating the figure's pale skin and the ground. The hair should flow upward organically. The overall texture should be grainy and atmospheric with no bubbles.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a thin, widely-spaced serif font in a very pale blue, placed in the upper negative space to maintain the sense of scale.

verificationChecks: Is the color palette strictly monochromatic blue?
Is the hair flowing upward to indicate weightlessness?
Is there a soft spotlight effect from the bottom?
Is the upper half of the image mostly empty negative space?

mustRedesign: Avoid clear water or pool tiles
Avoid visible breathing apparatus or bubbles
postGenerationChecks: Ensure no air bubbles are visible
Check that the skin tone looks luminous but blue-tinted
Verify the grain is uniform across the image
Confirm the subject appears to be floating, not standing
recipe.reuseFormula: Create a [monochromatic blue] underwater portrait of a [crouched figure] with [upward-flowing hair]. Use a [diffused bottom-up spotlight] to create [luminous skin] against a [grainy, deep indigo void]. Maintain [large negative space] at the top.
